body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production eight-direction BODY-ONLY sprite sheet for Last on Grid, grounded detailed hand-painted 2994 abandoned-world racing game. Original fictional Dewskipper tiny two-seat rear-engine targa sports car, inspired only by small early2000s European roadster packaging, NOT a replica. Faded orange body, charcoal structural roof hoop and sill, cream repair front fender, short low hood, small distinctive triangular inset headlights, narrow split rear lamps, low removable hardtop installed. No logos or text. Exact3:1 canvas,4columns2rows equal8cells: top FRONT, FRONT-RIGHT nose LEFT, RIGHT SIDE nose LEFT, REAR-RIGHT rear RIGHT; bottom REAR, REAR-LEFT rear LEFT, LEFT SIDE nose RIGHT, FRONT-LEFT nose RIGHT. Consistent same car and scale, whole body centered with margins in eachcell. All wheel arches are EMPTY TRANSPARENT HOLES through the car, no wheels, tires, hubs or dark wheelwell backing anywhere. Truly transparent background and wheelholes, no ground shadows or scenery. Subtle scrapes rust and repairs but drivable. Diffuse consistent light, detailed clean readable game artwork.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production original fictional Dewskipper 2004 cockpit foreground PNG for Last on Grid 2994 salvage racing. Tiny two-seat rear-engine targa sports car, RIGHT HAND DRIVE. Faded orange exterior, charcoal roof hoop, cream repair trim. Detailed grounded hand-painted weathered dark charcoal low sporty dashboard. Very wide2.5:1 driver-eye first-person view. Windshield completely transparent, no sky/scenery; continuous dashboard lowerhalf to bottomedge. Large empty dark recessed instrument binnacle on RIGHT at74%width,70%height, wide enough for runtime speed RPM gear numerals. No drawn gauges, numbers, needles, steeringwheel or hands; game overlays shared wheel at74%width and83%height, so leave instrument face unobstructed. Compact center vents/knobs, small robot-era repaired plastic, orange stitches, cream passenger grabhandle. No logos or text. Plausible small abandoned but drivable car, subdued consistent diffuse light, clean silhouettes.
